title: Personal Assistant to CEO
description:
As the Personal Assistant to the CEO of GigaBrands, you will play a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation of daily tasks and enhancing productivity. This dynamic position requires a proactive individual who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled in multitasking. You will manage the CEO’s calendar, coordinate travel arrangements, and handle correspondence, ensuring that all commitments are met efficiently.

Your ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively will be vital as you liaise with internal teams and external partners. You will also assist in project management, coordinate meetings, and prepare documentation, all while maintaining a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.

Bring your strong communication skills and problem-solving abilities to support the CEO in achieving strategic goals, while also fostering a positive work environment within the organization.

  • Proven experience as a Personal Assistant or in a similar role supporting senior executives
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficiency in office software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace)
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion
  • Proactive and flexible mindset to adapt to changing priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Experience in project management is a plus
  • Availability to work additional hours if required
  • The chance to combine professional coordination with social engagement
  • Exposure to diverse people, projects, and creative networks in Brazil and abroad
  • A flexible role that blends structure with variety
  • Opportunities to learn about personal branding, media, and international networking
  • A supportive, dynamic environment that values initiative and balance

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
WhiteWater makes products, but we are a service business at our heart, which means we are a people business. In this way, we excel and create value for our clients by listening to their needs, collaborating to develop solutions, problem‑solving and attending to the details. Our culture, as you would expect, reflects these traits. We are a diverse group of experts, from creative designers to talented engineers. Whatever expertise we bring from all over the world, we listen and learn from each other because we are aligned with a clearly understood purpose. Together, we create fun for families globally. Are you interested in starting an exciting career with WhiteWater? Apply today!

Position

Sales Coordinator

Shift

Regular Full Time, hours a week

Department

Sales Operation

Location

Rio de Janeiro / São Paulo, Brazil

Reports to

VP & RVP, Latin America

Purpose

Reporting to the VP Business Development, this role acts as the central hub between sales and our customers (both internal customers as well as external) by providing sales support and service to expand Business Development / project service efforts in Latin America. This person will also be responsible for compiling and preparing presentations, proposals and contracts as needed. The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience as a professionally mature self‑starter, who is able to balance multiple projects and move them forward independently, while working collaboratively with sales ops and the project management team.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Assist in the development of supporting materials for proposals and presentations, eg, product feature sheets, standard drawings, etc.
  • Obtain deliverables from departments and team members to design, build, print and deliver compelling and dynamic Proposal Books and Presentations
  • Researching and preparing market reports on various market segments in the Latin America region.
  • Assisting the VP Business Development on market development strategies.
  • Researching and preparing competitor reports for the Latin America region.
  • Preparing presentations, sales and marketing packages and distributing to existing and prospective clients.
  • Responding to client leads and inquiries via phone, email or in-person.
  • Proactive Lead Generation through market research and client identification
  • Inputting information and extracting information from a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
  • Attending and supporting Whitewater sales personnel at trade shows and conferences, as required.
  • Supporting the VP in the Latin America region with sales material and information as required.
  • Traveling to various client and partner sites, or other venues, as required (up to %).
  • Supporting the Project Services Department at Whitewater headquarters in Canada with clients requests, warranty and performance issues, as well as spare parts sales opportunities

Qualification & Experience

  • Experience working in a global organization
  • University degree in business, marketing, Graphic Design or equivalent
  • Minimum years’ experience in a similar role (providing administrative support to Leadership / Executives & remote based staff)
  • Expert in Adobe Creative Cloud (CC) such as In‑Design, Photoshop, Illustrator
  • Proven proficiency of Microsoft Office Suites
  • Experience working on contracts, proposals and / or presentations is an asset
  • Experience using Microsoft Dynamics CRM would be an asset
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English required. Spanish would be an asset

Competencies, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and administrative skills with the ability to work with minimum direction and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously with keen attention to detail.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain effective internal and external working relationships with all levels of the organization.
  • Proven ability to work well with diverse groups.
  • Ability to handle difficult clients and situations.
  • Able to prioritize and manage time effectively.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Hands on, roll up your sleeves, do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Able to meet tight deadlines in a fast paced, fun and professional environment.

Whitewater Competencies

  • Accountability – We do what we say
  • Collaboration – We work well together
  • Customer Focus – We know and respond to our customers
  • Communication – We listen to and understand each other
  • Authenticity – We are honest and trust each other
  • Resilience – We deal effectively with pressure, are persistent and optimistic
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – We are willing and able to respond to changing circumstance

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Pleno | Supply Chain
description:
Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Pleno | Supply Chain

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional para garantir o cumprimento das metas através da comercialização de produtos e serviços TOTVS com um processo que permita buscar um suspect, compreender suas necessidades, apresentar produtos e serviços, gerar oportunidades, propor, adequar, vender e entregar soluções, sempre mantendo um contínuo relacionamento técnico e empresarial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do AR nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Prospectar novos negócios na base instalada e/ou em novos clientes, visando ampliar Market Share TOTVS (Hunter);
  • Planejar e executar o plano tático alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da DRG e resultados de vendas no segmento/região de atuação;
  • Ser especialista e liderar o assunto no seu negócio, sendo capaz de estabelecer discursos e formas de atuação altamente adequadas ao perfil de cada cliente/prospect/segmento;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas individuais e metas de venda do time do Comercial em que estiver atuando, de acordo com a estratégia da TOTVS;
  • Visitar e assistir a base instalada e os novos clientes, garantindo sempre a excelência do atendimento TOTVS e buscando recorrentemente novos negócios;
  • Atender e se relacionar com o mercado e com a base instalada, através de visitas, reuniões, contatos telefônicos e e-mails;
  • Planejar, executar e liderar o processo de vendas de um produto ou serviço TOTVS ao mercado;
  • Levantar e analisar as informações do negócio, compilar e montar um plano de trabalho apoiado pela metodologia de vendas TOTVS;
  • Registrar no CRM e comunicar a área de Estratégia Comercial/Operações e Segmentos, informações relevantes sobre mercado/carteira;
  • Atuar como facilitador para a solução das demandas dos clientes e prospects;
  • Realizar a interface com as áreas internas da TOTVS;
  • Entregar e acompanhar a entrega dos produtos e/ou serviços TOTVS, garantindo que os acordos sejam cumpridos e os objetivos atendidos;
  • Realizar pós-venda com o objetivo de garantir o atendimento e gerar novas oportunidades (Cross Sell e Up Sell);
  • Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Ser referência técnica e comercial no seu segmento de atuação;
  • Exercer liderança informal na equipe, apoiando diretamente a gestão formal da empresa;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de executivos com alto nível de performance, atuando como buddy para novos TOTVERs;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência com vendas B2B de software de tecnologia e ERP;
  • Perfil Hunter, de prospecção de novos negócios;
  • Familiaridade com segmento de Supply Chain.
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para TOTVERS e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

Sobre a empresa

Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance. Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente! Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes. Vem com a gente inovar e construir o futuro da tecnologia. #VemPraTOTVS #SomosTOTVS

title: Tech Talent Program 2026
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for curious, analytical, and forward-thinking problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien as part of our Tech Talent Program 2026 in a full-time position.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of physics, mathematics, and technology to solve challenges across energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside industry experts, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects that redefine how we explore and understand the Earth’s subsurface.

To support your success, we provide structured onboarding, comprehensive technical training, and ongoing mentorship. You will learn how to transform raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D subsurface models, generating insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental stewardship.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to tackle complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and improve algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Research and Software Development teams to help shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and support innovation across the organization and the wider geophysical community.

About the Team

You will join a supportive and collaborative team working on real-world geophysical challenges.

Our culture is driven by science, sparked by collaboration, and propelled by ambition — pillars that reflect what makes working at Viridien unique and exciting. They shape how we learn from each other, tackle complex problems, and grow together in an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and continuous development from day one.

Qualifications

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a genuine interest in innovation and continuous learning.

Benefits

At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Meal voucher.
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu therapy available on site.
  • TotalPass fitness program.
  • Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week).
  • Birthday day off.
  • Christmas gift card.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\'t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Must Haves

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Complete Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
    • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
    • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
    • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
    • Strong SQL and Python skills.
    • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with theOURCES with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.

    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving моделей of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.
Legacy Development

Communication & Stakeholder Relations
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.

title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience (Independent Contractor)
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

Scope of Services

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

1. Project Overview

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective’s countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

2. Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

A. Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)

  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective
  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification
  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil
  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives

B. Grant making process support (approximately 40%)

  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil
  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos
  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria
  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team
  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation

C. Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)

  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes
  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use
  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

3. Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

4. Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

5. Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced
  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed
  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered
  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

6. Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills/ Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone
  • Ability to commit for six months

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

description:
A Beegol é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em diagnóstico inteligente de redes. Quer dar o próximo passo na carreira trabalhando todos os dias com modelos de linguagem de ponta em produção? Vem com a gente!

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

  • Atuar no treinamento, fine-tuning e avaliação de Large Language Models (LLMs) voltados a produtos em produção.
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados (coleta, limpeza, transformação e versionamento) com foco em qualidade e reprodutibilidade.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura de agentes de IA e na integração desses componentes aos nossos produtos e APIs.
  • Contribuir ativamente em code reviews, definição de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos nossos sistemas de ML em produção.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com outros engenheiros(as) e times de produto, ajudando a transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções baseadas em LLMs.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Experiência sólida com Python e SQL: desenvolvimento de scripts, ETLs e integrações; consultas otimizadas e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Conhecimento prático em machine learning em produção, incluindo experiência com LLMs (uso de APIs, fine-tuning, prompt engineering ou avaliação de modelos).
  • Experiência comprovada em AWS, incluindo pelo menos alguns destes serviços: API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, Fargate ou equivalentes de orquestração/containerização.
  • Vivência com ambientes de produção: monitoramento básico, logs, versionamento de modelos ou pipelines, boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Inglês intermediário: capaz de ler documentação técnica e escrever mensagens/PRs em inglês, quando necessário.
  • Formação completa em Ciência/Engenharia da Computação, Data Science, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Ter alguns anos de experiência (ou equivalente em projetos intensivos) trabalhando com dados, ML ou desenvolvimento de software em ambiente profissional.

DIFERENCIAIST

  • Ter colocado em produção soluções envolvendo LLMs e/ou agentes de IA (projetos profissionais ou autorais bem estruturados).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (por exemplo, Terraform).
  • Familiaridade com MLOps (tracking de experimentos, versionamento de modelos/datasets, CI/CD para ML).
  • Participação ativa em code reviews, definição de padrões de código e documentação técnica.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com autonomia, responsabilidade sobre entregas e grande vontade de aprender novas tecnologias.

COMO TRABALHAMOS

Modelo híbrido para São Paulo (capital) ou remoto (demais localidades).

Regime PJ, com atuação em tempo mínimo de 40 horas semanais. Horário flexível, com foco em resultados, mas é importante ter disponibilidade para participar de reuniões de alinhamento e colaboração com o time. Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte de mentoria, trocas técnicas frequentes e aprendizado contínuo.

  • Gerir problemas diários junto aos transportadores de forma colaborativa e construtiva, identificar oportunidades de melhoria no processo de ponta a ponta e identificar melhorias na área;

  • Servir de elo de ligação entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos no dia-a-dia.

  • Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários parceiros de coleta simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes de sua estação;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados;
  • MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);

title: Building Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! This information is provided for prospective applicants. Benefits details can be found at the university benefits site.

Job Purpose

The Building Manager ensures the smooth operation of teaching, research and office space, and acts as a liaison between the Chemistry Department, Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Physical Facilities Management (PFM) team. The candidate must have a strong understanding of building systems and chemistry laboratories. The successful candidate will oversee and participate in needed maintenance and repairs of the building to ensure functional integrity for teaching and research.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include staff, students and faculty.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serves as the main contact for the Chemistry Department for routine and emergency maintenance and repair requests.
  • Monitor the building condition (particularly the laboratory space) by performing regular inspections, and schedule routine maintenance (e.g., fume hoods, HVAC, and roof). Report maintenance or cleaning needs to the department staff.
  • Assist the department with submission of work orders to PFM as needed and monitor progress.
  • Oversee the work of vendors and contractors by maintaining standing orders and managing professional relationships; and provide building access to outside vendors and contractors.
  • Work closely with faculty and staff to provide solutions to facility-related problems.
  • Design, plan, or assist in renovation/modification projects to meet specific department or research needs or to correct building problems, requiring an understanding of structural design and department needs.
  • Respond to building emergencies, and serve as the primary emergency contact 24 hours a day throughout the year, including semester breaks, weekends, and holidays.
  • Assist faculty, staff and graduate students with shipping, receiving, and moving tasks.
  • Installation of some laboratory equipment, cabinetry, shelving, etc.
  • Communicate with the appropriate Facilities staff when the work order is not completed within a reasonable time frame.
  • Serve as a liaison to Public Safety, PFM, EHS, and other university entities in emergency response situations and for safety-related topics.
  • Supervision of small groups of student workers.

Laboratory Safety

  • Troubleshoot and advise on problems that arise regarding the safety of building or laboratory facilities.
  • Check safety showers and eyewash stations weekly to ensure their working conditions.
  • Remain up to date with University safety training.
  • Act as a department contact for Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS).
  • Understand hazardous material safety guidelines per University protocols.
  • Work with EHS on proper handling of hazardous waste materials from teaching and research laboratories.
  • Assist in chemical/solvent deliveries as necessary.
  • Develop and execute response plans for safety, security, and business continuity.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Chemistry Department.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five years of related experience in a variety of trades relevant to general building functions including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and mechanical; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of building materials and methods.
  • Proven supervisory skills.
  • Abilities to use Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work with faculty members, staff, and students.
  • Valid driver’s license (ability to drive University vehicles).
  • Ability to climb ladders, kneel, reach above the shoulder, stand and/or walk for extended periods of time and may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in specifying and purchasing parts or equipment.
  • Experience working in chemistry laboratory/research setting.
  • Understanding and minor maintenance of water purification systems, laboratory hoods, and electronic locksets.
  • Ability to engage, connect, and work with diverse student, administrative, and faculty populations and provide a commitment to the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion in an educational setting.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$65,000-$75,000

title: Metering Engineer
description:
This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM).
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO.
  • Participate/assist in metering audits.
  • Act as Technical Authority to measurement issues.
  • Verify that FPSO operator’s procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards.
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP.
  • Keep updated the measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system).
  • Validate offloading measurement reports.
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation.
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades.
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions.
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes.
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading / unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers.
  • Follow up the routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems.
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written).

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável pelo suporte técnico prestado aos usuários, pela manutenção e implantação de equipamentos, programas e sistemas, e pelo planejamento e desempenho da área de TI na unidade. Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

title: Ubuntu Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable with designing and engineering new software as they are with packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Teams that ship Ubuntu

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters : a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
  • Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
  • Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
  • Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
  • Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

This application track is suitable for those at the mid point in their career but perhaps not quite at the Manager/Lead level, with relevant skills to contribute to Ubuntu.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

The role entails

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

  • Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go and Python
  • Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
  • Debugging system-level issues and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring their colleagues to build skills and understanding
  • Developing and improving processes to more efficiently fulfill our goals

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • A demonstrated passion for open source software
  • Significant experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with Linux distributions and distribution engineering
  • Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Performance or Security Engineering experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Location

Fully remote position.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.

title: FPSO HSE Advisor
description:
Contexte et environnement

O FPSO HSE Advisor trabalha em regime de rotação (14x14– 2 pessoas em rotação para 1 posição) e passa 100% do tempo offshore em ambiente de campo com as seguintes características:

  • Contexto de Afretamento e Operação;
  • Ambiente multicultural com nível de atividades em rápido crescimento;
  • Contexto desafiador de legislação e licenciamento de HSE;
  • O FPSO HSE Advisor possui forte interface com equipe de HSE do Contratado no site. Questões importantes e incidentes devem ser imediatamente reportados ao CSR/RSES no local.

Activités

  • Facilita e assegura a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas brasileiras de HSE em todas as operações;
  • Mantém registros e documentação relacionados a HSE e garante que o Contratado cumpra os requisitos acordados de retenção de registros conforme contrato;
  • Apoia o CSR/RSES na implementação do processo de notificação de incidentes da afiliada;
  • Mantém o dossiê de HSE atualizado com arquivos e registros conforme exigido pelas Regras da Companhia (CR) e Especificações Gerais (GS);
  • Compila e registra informações e documentação de HSE solicitadas/liberadas por órgãos reguladores durante auditorias, inspeções ou investigações no site;
  • Participa de HAZID, HAZOP e Análise de Causa Raiz; participa dos programas de Segurança da companhia como “Safety Green Light”, “Life Saving Checks”, auditorias de Permissão de Trabalho, palestras de segurança; participa da reunião semanal de segurança;
  • Assegura que todos os procedimentos operacionais usados para Descarga Operacional e Plano de Medição de Gás (como parte da ISO 14001/ISO 50001) sejam seguidos dentro das limitações do processo e alinhados aos objetivos de Produção/Injeção.

Requisitos Legais e da Companhia

  • Facilita e assegura a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas brasileiras de HSE em todas as operações;
  • Mantém registros e documentação relacionados a HSE e garante que o Contratado cumpra os requisitos acordados de retenção de registros conforme contrato;
  • Apoia o CSR/RSES na implementação do processo de notificação de incidentes da afiliada;
  • Mantém o dossiê de HSE atualizado com arquivos e registros conforme exigido pelas Regras da Companhia (CR) e Especificações Gerais (GS);
  • Compila e registra informações e documentação de HSE solicitadas/liberadas por órgãos reguladores durante auditorias, inspeções ou investigações no site;

  • Assegura que todos os procedimentos operacionais usados para Descarga Operacional e Plano de Medição de Gás (como parte da ISO 14001/ISO 50001) sejam seguidos dentro das limitações do processo e alinhados aos objetivos de Produção/Injeção.

Responsabilidade Operacional, Cultura de HSE e Comunicação

  • Participa/lidera reuniões pré-tarefa, palestras de segurança, reuniões de progresso, debriefings e garante que os trabalhadores estejam presentes, informados e conscientes da tarefa;
  • Desenvolve, implementa e ministra treinamentos de integração de HSE em nome da Companhia;
  • Apoia campanhas de HSE, iniciativas de conscientização, programas de comportamento e reconhecimento em nome da Companhia;
  • Facilita e orienta programas de coaching e mentoring de HSE para todo o pessoal no site;

  • Implementa iniciativas dos programas de Segurança da companhia como “Safety Green Light”, “Life Saving Checks”, auditorias de permissão de trabalho, Diálogo de Segurança etc.;

Gestão de Riscos

  • Identifica e aborda riscos de HSE e fornece orientação sobre medidas preventivas e corretivas; elabora planos de ação conforme solicitado;

  • Utiliza ferramentas disponíveis (LSC – “Life Saving Checks”) para garantir que as operações sejam gerenciadas adequadamente.

Meio Ambiente

  • Apoia a implementação de planos e programas ambientais no site em nome da Companhia;
  • Garante que o Contratado possua, acompanhe, revise e atualize planos de gestão ambiental, gestão de resíduos, gestão de produtos químicos, entre outros;

  • Projeto de Monitoramento Ambiental (PMA);
  • Projeto de Controle da Poluição (PCP);

  • Administra sistemas de rastreamento de registros ambientais no site.

  • Apoia a implementação de planos e programas de higiene industrial no site;
  • Verifica a seleção e aquisição adequadas de EPIs e equipamentos de segurança da Companhia no site.

Treinamento e Competência

  • Educa, motiva e treina pessoal da Companhia e do Contratado em questões de HSE;
  • Controla a conformidade da matriz de treinamentos de HSE do Contratado;
  • Aplica o PEAT (Projeto de Educação Ambiental dos Trabalhadores) para todo o pessoal a bordo do FPSO.

Gestão de Emergências

  • Apoia a aplicação do sistema de resposta a emergências conforme requisitos do documento de interface;
  • Participa de exercícios organizados no site pela Companhia e/ou Contratado;
  • Acompanha plano de ações de melhoria após os exercícios;
  • Controla disponibilidade e adequação de equipamentos de resposta a emergências (combate a incêndio, SOPEP etc.) e primeiros socorros.

Auditorias, Inspeções e Revisões

  • Realiza inspeções diárias nas áreas de trabalho, condições e permissões de trabalho;
  • Realiza inspeções nos alojamentos em intervalos regulares;
  • Participa de auditorias programadas e não programadas com a gestão da Companhia, Contratado e outras partes aplicáveis;
  • Lidera e apoia CSR/RSES em auditorias do Sistema de Gestão de HSE/ISO 14001/ISO 50001.

Gestão de Eventos, Melhoria de Performance e Gestão de Dados

  • Reporta desempenho de HSE do Contratado: documenta, acompanha anomalias, quase-acidentes, incidentes e qualquer outro evento de HSE no site conforme requisitos da Companhia;
  • Propõe ações para melhoria contínua de HSE no site;
  • Participa de investigações de quase-acidentes no site;
  • Atua como condutor de análises de causa raiz para Acidentes de alo potencial a bordo do FPSO – monitora os planos de ação;
  • Auxilia o CSR/RSES na condução e gestão dos sistemas de Controle de Risco de Segurança e Meio Ambiente; investiga causas raiz de incidentes e acidentes e define ações corretivas relevantes.

Gestão Social

  • No âmbito do Projeto de Comunicação Social (PCS), monitora, contata por rádio e registra 100% das embarcações não autorizadas que entram na zona de exclusão de 500 m do FPSO.

Profil du candidat

A posição requer um diploma de engenharia de uma universidade reconhecida no Brasil, bem como experiência na indústria de óleo e gás, em uma função de HSE.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Disposição para aplicar padrões e procedimentos de HSE de forma respeitosa e obter comprometimento do pessoal do Contratado;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e interação com gestão, supervisores e pessoal do site para coordenar trabalho seguro;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas e questões de forma independente e lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente;
  • Excelente conhecimento das regulamentações brasileiras de HSE (NR, CONAMA etc.);
  • Excelente compreensão dos requisitos, restrições e obrigações estabelecidos pela Licença de Operação;
  • Habilidade com programas e sistemas MS e aplicações (Synergi, Enablon, HRAF etc.).

Informations supplémentaires

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous os candidatos.
