  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Finance Coordinator provides administrative and financial operations support for the Development and Alumni Relations (DAR) department and serves as a critical liaison with procurement and accounts payable to ensure that financial activities associated with financial operations, philanthropic gifts, and grants are efficiently managed, maintained, and compliant with all applicable university policies, laws, and regulations. Additional responsibilities include managing procurement, accounts payable, and financial operations efficiently.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator assists with the development, management, and monitoring of the department\'s budget and financial operations. The role requires an experienced administrator with a strong background in bookkeeping, able to ensure the department\'s fiscal integrity and efficiency, and compliance with university policies. This position works collaboratively across DAR and extensively with colleagues in key financial offices, including the University Budget Office, Procurement and Contracting, and Accounts Payable. Will work with other campus partners as needed. Teamwork, collaboration, and effective communication both across the University and with other development staff, are essential.

Principal Accountabilities

Working closely with the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator primarily provides financial administrative support, including bookkeeping, entering requisitions, account reconciliation across the entire department. The role assists with managing and monitoring staff expenses to ensure the timely completion of expense reports. It supports the procurement process, including vendor selection, contract negotiation, and purchase order management, ensuring that all expenditures align with approved budget guidelines and university financial policies and procedures. Responsibilities include assisting with the preparation of financial reports and summaries for review by the Director of Administration and senior leadership, as well as assisting with the development of DAR’s annual budget and audits. The Finance Coordinator may also help to identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiencies within the department’s financial operations.

Core Competencies

  • Excellent administrative, bookkeeping, communication, and time management skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and work with data to inform reporting and task completion.
  • Ability to adhere to standard operating procedures to ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures.
  • Ability to navigate internal processes and structures to problem-solve, take initiative, and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently with purpose and accuracy in a fast-paced environment; and
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and a high degree of discretion.

Minimum Requirements

Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent work experience

  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in finance, accounting, or bookkeeping
  • Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Suite, excel and budgeting software, familiarity with Workday preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Salary Range: $65,000 - $80,000

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Note: This is a contract-to-hire position

MUST HAVE:

  • Demonstrated experience driving video performance, engagement, and watch time, ideally in a revenue-focused environment
  • Strong understanding of video syndication platforms (MSN preferred) and how they reward engagement
  • Hands-on experience with scriptwriting, editing feedback, and video optimization
  • Comfort managing freelancers, assigning work, and overseeing quality and deadlines
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects at once
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Willingness to experiment, test, and iterate quickly
  • Openness to incorporating AI tools into scripting, ideation, and workflow optimization

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years in video strategy, video production, or performance-driven video roles within digital media, performance marketing, or content monetization. Personal finance experience or familiarity strongly preferred.

YOUR ROLE

You’ll own the strategy, planning, and performance of FinanceBuzz’s video content, with a primary focus on syndication platforms (especially MSN) where revenue is driven by consumed seconds of video. Secondarily, you’ll support video publishing and optimization for YouTube and social platforms.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll be directly involved in topic selection, scripting, editing feedback, thumbnail and on-screen graphic optimization, and performance analysis. Your goal is simple but ambitious: scale video revenue significantly over time while maintaining high-quality, trustworthy personal finance content.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching, comfort working with performance data, and the ability to manage multiple contributors and workflows at once. You should be equally comfortable zooming out to plan a content roadmap and zooming in to rewrite a script or leave frame-by-frame feedback.

This role is contract-to-hire and will play a key role in growing video from its current state (~$15K/month) into a $500K+ annual revenue stream.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Selecting video topics that consistently maximize viewer engagement, watch time, and revenue
  • Optimizing scripts to increase retention, clarity, and completion rates
  • Improving thumbnail and on-screen graphic performance through testing and iteration
  • Building and maintaining an efficient, scalable video workflow
  • Managing freelancers effectively: assigning work, giving clear feedback, and coordinating payments and budgets
  • Maintaining high quality and brand consistency across all video content
  • Monitoring video performance metrics and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Growing video revenue from its current level toward a $500K+ annual run rate
  • Establishing FinanceBuzz as a trusted and engaging personal finance video brand

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the video content strategy for syndication platforms, with a primary focus on MSN
  • Plan and maintain the video content calendar
  • Write, edit, and optimize video scripts
  • Provide detailed feedback to video editors and designers
  • Optimize thumbnails, titles, and on-screen graphics for engagement
  • Oversee video production workflows for speed, quality, and consistency
  • Manage freelance contributors and coordinate with internal stakeholders on budgets and payments
  • Conduct quality control on all video outputs
  • Track and report on video performance metrics and revenue

COMPETENCIES

  • Performance-Driven: Obsessed with engagement, watch time, and revenue outcomes
  • Detail-Oriented: Catches issues before they go live and pushes for constant improvement
  • Strategic & Tactical: Thinks big-picture while staying deeply involved in execution
  • Ownership Mentality: Treats the video business as their own and takes responsibility for results
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-changing environment and adjusts strategy based on performance data
  • Collaborative: Works closely with editorial, design, and operations partners
  • Coachability: Welcomes feedback and actively seeks ways to improve systems and output

  • Elaboração do orçamento anual (budget) da empresa, consolidando e analisando dados e realizando forecasts semanais, mensais e trimestrais;

Superior Completo em Administração / Economia / Engenharia e/ou áreas correlatas.

Obrigatórias

description:
Overview

The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.
  • Establish and manage client projects.
  • May update and inform the Global Sustainability team on regulatory changes and their impact on ABS business.
  • May conduct seminars and workshops related to the environmental performance of marine vessels and offshore units.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents.
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate
  • May attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends
  • Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met
  • May identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM
  • Works as a team member within the group, but may work autonomously most of the time

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Requires a BSc in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on environmental performance.
  • MSc degree preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of four (4) years of related engineering experience in a recognized research university, research institute, shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & writt en), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

Reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

title: Python/Django Software Engineer
description:
Overview

WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US? At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Responsibilities

  • Your role: Develop, deliver, document and support robust and stable backend application features, third-party integrations and infrastructure across a breadth of services and environments.
  • Outcomes (Performance Expectations):
    • Backend Application Features & Third-Party Integrations
      • Support the development and implementation of backend features and integrations across both legacy and new systems.
      • Collaborate with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business needs.
      • Contribute to feasibility discussions and support early-stage prototyping with guidance from peers.
    • Service Reliability & Code Execution
      • Implement backend functionality with attention to performance, readability, and maintainability.
      • Follow team patterns and contribute to test coverage, including basic post-deployment and load testing scripts.
      • Escalate reliability or performance concerns and partner with senior engineers to resolve them.
    • Monitoring & Issue Resolution
      • Help maintain and improve application monitoring by setting up or adjusting alerts, dashboards, or logs.
      • Participate in debugging and resolving production issues, with support from senior team members.
      • Document fixes and share learnings to strengthen team awareness and incident response.
    • Infrastructure & Deployment Support
      • Support infrastructure tasks using established tools (e.g., Terraform, ECS, Lambda) under guidance.
      • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines and participate in identifying workflow improvements.
    • Code Quality & Collaboration
      • Write maintainable, testable code using frameworks like Django and testing tools such as Pytest.
      • Engage in code reviews with a learning mindset and contribute to a culture of quality and shared ownership.
      • Pair with teammates to troubleshoot issues and improve knowledge of system architecture.
    • Product Awareness & Team Contribution
      • Build awareness of how backend systems connect to product goals and customer outcomes.
      • Share observations that could improve team workflows, code quality, or product performance.
      • Seek clarity on priorities and outcomes to ensure engineering effort supports business value.
  • Competencies
    • Collaborative: Open to feedback, communicates clearly across functions, and adds value through shared knowledge (especially during pull request reviews).
    • Curious & Proactive: Suggests improvements in tooling, deployment, or infrastructure and thinks beyond assigned tasks.
    • Detail-Oriented: Writes maintainable, testable code with a strong grasp of debugging principles and Python design patterns.
    • Execution-Driven: Manages time effectively, prioritizes impact, and consistently meets engineering goals without micromanagement.
    • Growth Mindset: Seeks to understand LP’s products and business context to make informed backend decisions and support data-driven goals.
  • Nice to Haves
    • Track record of backend engineering support for Content Management Systems (CMS) preferred
    • Experience with NextJS systems

Qualifications

  • EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of professional development experience using Python and deploying backend systems using Python frameworks like Django or FastAPI.
  • Must Have: Experience with containerized Python/Django (or FastAPI) services, including deployment on AWS.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting production bugs in systems with limited QA support.
  • Strong grasp of SQL databases, CI/CD (especially CircleCI), containerized solutions, and infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred).
  • Comfortable contributing ideas, giving peer feedback via pull requests, and driving technical improvements autonomously.

Additional Details

description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Primary Objectives

  • Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem
  • Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations
  • Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors
  • Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance
  • Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems

title: Venue Design Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

Key responsibilities

Raw Data Management

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards:

  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

Drawing Updates:

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 workflows:

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements:

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications:

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration:

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
  • Excellent organisational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent drawing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of local construction regulations and permitting processes in host country (desirable).
    Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Linux Devices Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Apply here for all engineering teams at Canonical who work on low-level system technology on autonomous devices across all seniority levels.

Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices.

These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance.

Canonical builds Ubuntu Core, a fully containerised version of Ubuntu that is mathematically precise and rigorously secure. We are working on additional solutions for even smaller devices.

Location

Remote roles open in every time zone.

Roles Included

  • Ubuntu Core and snapd software development

What your day will look like

  • Work with the latest Linux kernel and open source technologies
  • Deliver Ubuntu for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms
  • Integrate and maintain device-oriented software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed software
  • Collaborate proactively with other globally distributed teams
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Help our customers ship their apps and SDKs on Ubuntu

  • Optimise the Ubuntu kernel and libraries for silicon-specific capabilities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them

  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Work usually from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Passion for Linux or embedded systems software (e.g. kernel, graphics, Yocto)
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience with firmware, uboot, UEFI, ACPI, DSDT, or boot loaders
  • Experience with power management on PCI ASPM, SATA ALPM, low power profiles
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V
  • Experience in board design, bring up, and validation
  • Experience with electrical engineering design tools (e.g. schematic capture, layout)
  • Familiarity with Ubuntu development model
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Shell or Python scripting skills

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Comunicação Corporativa. Este papel é fundamental para atender às necessidades de um dos principais players do mercado brasileiro de petróleo.

O desafio envolve planejar, desenvolver e monitorar a comunicação de uma gerência do setor de Exploração e Produção de O&G, garantindo qualidade, clareza e alinhamento estratégico em todas as comunicações da gerência. Você será responsável por criar o plano de comunicação, implementar métricas que demonstrem a efetividade das ações e liderar iniciativas que assegurem que as mensagens estejam conectadas aos objetivos e metas da área, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e de alto engajamento.

Main responsibilities

Principais atividades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano de comunicação da área, alinhado aos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Realizar diagnósticos de percepção do público e propor ações de melhoria baseadas em técnicas como ADKAR ou outras;
  • Desenvolvimento de formas de comunicação (páginas web, comunicados em e-mail, postagem em redes sociais, notícias, vídeos) que comuniquem as transformações no processo de Operação & Manutenção;
  • Propor materiais institucionais que capturem a atenção do público‑alvo com divulgação em diferentes meios e alinhados às diretrizes da área de Comunicação Empresarial da Petrobras;
  • Orientar e direcionar a elaboração de narrativas para o desenvolvimento de peças de comunicação internas demandadas pelas áreas e aplicáveis a diferentes objetivos e públicos-alvo e auxiliar na confecção e/ou revisão de textos, de modo a tornar a comunicação clara, objetiva, estratégica, atrativa e efetiva em relação ao objetivo estabelecido;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de relatórios gerenciais ou técnicos, com foco no leiaute e revisão de texto;
  • Planejamento e produção de conteúdo, elaboração de campanhas de caráter informativo e/ou pedagógico, organização de eventos, mensuração de resultados de postagens em mídias sociais internas;
  • Planejamento de campanhas, ações, estratégias, fluxos de trabalho, alcance de resultados e outros, que visem divulgar e perenizar novas soluções tecnológicas;
  • Desenvolver estratégias eficazes de comunicação corporativa (forma e conteúdo), direcionadas para diferentes públicos, da Alta Administração às frentes operacionais;
  • Elaboração de plano de ação de relacionamento para tratamento dos pontos críticos identificados no diagnóstico de percepção, sugerindo soluções de gestão do relacionamento a serem implementadas para cada público e para cada canal de relacionamento.
  • Apoio técnico para atuar na gestão, monitoramento e implantação das soluções e ações de relacionamento com o público de interesse, na análise de dados de pesquisas junto ao público de interesse, na implantação das soluções e ações do plano de relacionamento, no tratamento dos pontos críticos identificados e apresentados no diagnóstico de percepção e nas soluções de gestão do relacionamento a serem implementadas para cada público e para cada canal de relacionamento.
  • Desenvolver e/ou dar suporte à elaboração de planos de comunicação e/ou relacionamento, com foco em seus principais elementos e conteúdos, como diagnósticos, objetivos, estratégias, planos de ação, e instrumentos de avaliação.O serviço também engloba a coleta, análise, tratamento, registro, sistematização de informações e desenvolvimento e/ou aplicação de metodologias de planejamento.
  • Capturar oportunidades de desenvolvimento ou fortalecimento das ações de comunicação para divulgação das ações e resultados das atividades que são escopo de atuação da área.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

  • Integridade : Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado : Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Gente e Gestão (HRBP) para integrar o time da NTS. Essa pessoa será responsável por implementar estratégias e diretrizes da área, conduzindo os processos de Gente com foco em promover um ambiente saudável, colaborativo e orientado para entregas de excelência.

Buscamos alguém com perfil estratégico e relacional, que atuará como Business Partner, apoiando líderes na tomada de decisões, impulsionando a cultura organizacional e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das equipes.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como Business Partner para diferentes áreas da companhia, oferecendo consultoria interna em temas de Gente & Gestão;
  • Realizar pesquisas de satisfação e promover ações de melhoria contínua;
  • Disseminar políticas, normas, procedimentos e processos organizacionais;
  • Aprovar requisições de abertura de novas posições e alinhar perfil das vagas com gestores e equipe de Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Participar dos processos seletivos, apoiando gestores na tomada de decisão;

  • Identificar e viabilizar ações de desenvolvimento para equipes;
  • Conduzir o ciclo de carreira e sucessão, facilitando comitês e aplicando metodologias;
  • Acompanhar processos de desligamento com foco em cuidado e alinhamento organizacional;
  • Definir diretrizes e interfaces necessárias para o processo de desligamento;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance das áreas atendidas e tratar desvios identificados;

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability.

Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities.

We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

Key responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management.
    FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

Your profile

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Start date: 01 March (tentative or to be agreed)

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates’s football.

Overview

Professional English is a requirement for this role. A challenge will be required.

About Foundey
Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States.

We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.)
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. Youll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

Overview

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

  • Accreditation Documentation & Content Management: Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Training Material Development & Delivery: Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.
  • Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination: Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

Your profile

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for protecting the organization's information systems and digital assets by developing, implementing, and maintaining technical security controls. This role includes conducting security assessments, monitoring systems for vulnerabilities or intrusions, and ensuring that the organization’s IT environment remains compliant with industry and regulatory standards such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. The engineer also plays a critical role in incident detection, response, and prevention.

Supervisory Authority

NONE

Nature And Scope

Operating in a dynamic threat landscape, the Cybersecurity Engineer reports to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity and works with other IT, compliance, and business stakeholders. Although not a supervisory role, the Cybersecurity Engineer may guide junior staff or external contractors and lead technical implementation efforts on security‑related projects. The role demands staying up to date on emerging threats, tools, and best practices, and proactively evolving the organization's defenses accordingly.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security configuration reviews.
  • Evaluate system and application hardening measures using CIS benchmarks and STIGs.
  • Monitor networks and endpoints using tools like SIEM, EDR, and IDS/IPS (e.g., CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
  • Analyze security events and logs to detect, triage, and respond to threats.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools, including:
    • Firewalls
    • Network Access Control (NAC)
    • Antivirus/Endpoint Protection
    • DLP, CASB, and vulnerability management platforms
  • Develop and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external frameworks such as NIST 800‑53, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI DSS.
  • Develop and deliver training on phishing, password hygiene, and secure computing practices.
  • Support tabletop exercises and simulation drills to test security readiness.
  • Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security into system architecture.
  • Participate in project reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the system development lifecycle.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in the following:
    • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
    • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, CA
    • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
    • Falcon Crowdstrike
    • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
    • Hybrid cloud integrations
    • Authentication protocols
    • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper‑V).
  • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE.
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations.
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security.
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Deep understanding of encryption, PKI, authentication, secure networking, and operating system security across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Proficient in analyzing logs, threat intelligence, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) to drive timely threat mitigation.
  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Methodical and responsive approach to detecting, responding to, and remediating security incidents.
  • Works cross‑functionally with IT, audit, compliance, and legal to promote enterprise‑wide security awareness and enforcement.
  • Careful review of systems, code, and configurations to identify small changes that may indicate large risks.
  • Able to shift priorities rapidly in response to new vulnerabilities, threat campaigns, or business requirements.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four‑year college or university in computer science/Information Technology with a security concentration. A master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Must have 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a security engineering role. One or more industry‑recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer Associate is required or strongly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate hands‑on expertise in network and application security architecture, cloud security controls across platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP, identity and access management (including IAM, SSO, and MFA), and security monitoring tools such as SIEM, SOAR, and EDR. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and secure DevSecOps practices is essential. A solid understanding of key regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements—including GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA, and FISMA—is also required. In addition to technical capabilities, the candidate should possess strong collaboration and critical thinking skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$130,000–$140,000

description:
Overview

Do you enjoy being part of a team that ensures a safe, healthy, and environmentally responsible workplace for everyone? Are you looking for a new challenge? Our Oilfield Services business provides intelligent, connected technologies to monitor and control our energy extraction assets and supporting facilities. Our team arranges technical expertise to meet our client expectation. We provide customers with the peace of mind needed to reliably and efficiently improve their operations.

Partner with the best

Responsible for ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations, while supporting the development of a strong safety culture across the organization. Acts as a technical reference for HSE matters, guiding teams and improving operational standards.

Senior HSE Technician – Responsibilities

  • Identifying and acting on legal requirements related to Occupational Safety and Environmental Management applicable to the company’s activities.
  • Standardizing safety procedures and administrative HSE controls through documentation, as well as standardizing task risk‑analysis controls in operational areas.
  • Monitoring Occupational Safety and Environmental indicators such as accidents, incidents, inspections, training, meetings, PPE usage, and other relevant metrics.
  • Conducting workplace inspections, identifying hazardous conditions, raising, investigating, and analyzing accidents, and reporting Safety‑related matters to leadership through daily reports.
  • Acting as a consultant on Emergency‑related matters in accordance with legal and normative requirements of NR‑23 and COSCIP.
  • Organizing legal documentation related to the HSE area.
  • Collaborating in training new Safety and Environmental Technicians, as well as preparing and delivering safety training to all employees, including awareness programs and dissemination of safety standards to promote preventive behavior.
  • Issuing Work Permits.
  • Advising the company on legal occupational hygiene programs (PPRA), identifying risks and specifying the appropriate PPE for workers.
  • Providing consultative support to HSE process and program management and to the use of internal tools such as Framework, Gensuite, and others, acting as element leader and/or substituting when necessary.
  • Developing and performing internal Risk Analyses, and reviewing Risk Analyses of third‑party activities.
  • Developing and executing medium‑ and high‑complexity HSE projects.
  • Coordinating and following up on operational HSE activities whenever necessary.
  • Ensuring that the company’s Health, Safety, and Environmental values are practiced by employees, suppliers, and contractors through the identification, monitoring, and control of significant environmental impacts and occupational risks, based on attitude, leadership, training, and commitment.
  • Working in accordance with company policies and procedures related to quality and operations, reporting any nonconformity, concern, or risk to the product/process/service, and being committed to achieving quality objectives and pursuing continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Holding a High School Diploma and a Technical Degree in Occupational Safety
  • Considering a degree in Engineering desirable
  • Bringing at least 5 years of experience demonstrating solid technical expertise in HSE activities
  • Using Microsoft Office
  • Having an advanced English
  • Requiring the accreditation as an Occupational Safety Technician with the Ministry of Labor (MTE)

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

GUARACAMP!

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.
